Commentary.Commentary: India continue their domination! The Men in Blue are clicking as a unit and it seems nothing can stand in their way. They are on the same points with the No. 1 ODI side in the world, South Africa. Another win will take them to the top of the tree and also help them take an unassailable lead in the series. Australia were good in patches but failed to pull off a collective performance. They need to get their act together if they are to stay alive in the competition. Join us for the 3rd ODI which will take place in Indore on 24th September at 1330 local (0800 GMT). Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Indian skipper and also the Man of the Match, VIRAT KOHLI is really happy with the win. Says he thought they didn't have enough on the board but felt that they can stand a chance if they bowl well and get a good start. Praises Bhuvneshwar Kumar for setting the tone for them and feels they can count on him if there is some assistance off the pitch. Adds the wicket wasn't that easy to bat on. On the wrist spinners, he says both (Chahal and Yadav) bowl with a lot of heart and provide the breakthroughs whenever needed. Mentions that he is happy to have all the bases covered. On his batting, Kohli replies he always tries to come out positive and respects the opposition at the same time. Reckons he was aware of the wicket today, knew Australia's bowling attack had quality and it needed something special to get going. Ends by saying it looks nice when it pays off.

Australian skipper, STEVEN SMITH says he was pretty happy with the target set as they pulled things back nicely in the first innings. Mentions that they crumbled under pressure, making some poor decisions and adds that they can't afford it against a quality side like India. Reckons Marcus Stoinis was pretty good in the end but someone needed to step up and score big. Informs that his team bowled really well and once again emphasizes on poor decisions which cost them. On the Indian bowlers, he says they have got all the bases covered, their fast bowlers swing the ball both ways and have great variety in the attack.

Both the Indian wrist spinners combined together to weave their magic. They took 5 wickets in 20 overs for 88 runs to dent the tourists. Kuldeep Yadav impressed the most, taking his maiden hat-trick in ODI cricket. Stoinis played an entertaining knock to keep his side in with an outside chance but the task proved to be too much for him and eventually, he was left stranded. A lot to ponder for Australia as they are now on a 10-match losing streak away from home (completed games).

Head and Smith got their eye in and formed a good partnership. Both of them played sensible cricket, targeted the loose deliveries and kept the scoreboard ticking. They were threatening to take the game away but Head lost his cool to throw his wicket away. Maxwell looked dangerous but Chahal outsmarted him. And after the Australian skipper returned to the pavilion, a collapse followed.

A brilliant performance from India and they have taken a 2-0 lead in the 5-match ODI series. This is their 8th consecutive win in ODIs, a commendable feat indeed! After posting a competitive total on this two-paced track, their bowlers came out firing on all cylinders, especially Kumar who jolted the visitors early by nipping out both the openers and nearly got Head as well.

OUT! The decision stands! And it's all over for Australia here. Bhuvneshwar Kumar was the one who took the first wicket and comes back now to seal the deal. Back of a length delivery, skidding a bit off the deck. Richardson walks across a touch to flick it away but misses and is struck on the pads. Kumar turns back to appeal and the finger goes up. Stoinis asks him to challenge the decision but to be honest it was looking out to the naked eye. Replays show it's in line and would have hit the leg stump. The Men in Blue extend their winning streak as they WIN BY 50 RUNS!
Richardson has a conversation with Stoinis and decides to take the review after being adjudged LBW. It is very close. Only an inside edge can save him.
BHUVNESHWAR KUMAR comes back into the attack. He bowled a great opening spell. Stoinis is looking threatening.
Good length delivery on off, Marcus pushes it past Bumrah. Wants the single but which is not on.
Good length delivery outside off, defended towards point.
Gets across and flicks it towards the leg side.
The umpires are checking the ball as it has taken quite a beating. They cut a bit of leather from the seam which was coming out.

SIX! Flick of the wrists! That's gone over the fence! Let me tell you, he is keeping the Aussie hopes alive. In a match against New Zealand, he scored an unbeaten 146 and nearly took his side across the line. Has a chance to do it today if he plays like this. A full toss on the pads, Stoinis just flicks it over deep backward square leg for a maximum.
Stays back and defends it towards point.
Fuller in length and angling in, worked off the pads towards mid-wicket.
JASPRIT BUMRAH is back into the attack.
On a length and around off, pushed towards the point fielder.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, clipped towards mid-wicket.
Shorter and outside off, slapped through point for a single.

SIX! Maiden ODI fifty for Stoinis! And what a way to get to that one. Gets this one in his arc and he slams it down the ground for a maximum all the way. Raises his bat to the dressing room and acknowledges the cheer. The task is way too much for him, but can he bring this close?
Lunges forward to a full ball and drives it towards the mid off fielder.
Angles in a length delivery on middle, tucked away towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Flatter and quicker through the air around leg, Kane goes back to work it away but it goes over the leg pole. A good take by Dhoni behind the stumps.
Kane has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Gets down and across to paddle it down to fine leg for a single.
SIX! That's flat and that's big! Sees the flight, skips down the track and bashes it down the ground for a maximum.
Second slip in place now.
Edged but doesn't carry! Gives it a nice loop, serves it full outside off. Stoinis looks to drive but gets an edge which dies in front of Virat at first slip.
Tossed up around off, defended down.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled by the umpire. Five fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings.

Edged but this time it falls short! Hardik keeps it in the channel on off, Kane has a push at it. Gets a thick outside edge towards first slip where Kohli bends low to take it but the ball falls well short of him. Richardson survives!

In the air... dropped! Tough chance though but a good effort from Chahal. Fuller ball outside off, Richardson drives it uppishly towards short cover where the leggie dives full stretch to his right to take it with one hand but the ball bursts through his fingers and rolls towards mid off.
KANE RICHARDSON is the last man in.

OUT! Caught and bowled! Hardik Pandya breaks the stubborn stand! Comes in and hits the deck hard, gets enough bounce to surprise Coulter-Nile. The batsman is hurried by it as he looks to pull. Gets a top edge that balloons in the air and Pandya calls for it. He takes it easily in the end.
Stoinis comes forward and drives it through covers for a single.
Once again on a fuller length, driven back to the bowler.
Fuller in length and outside off, Marcus drives it towards the man at mid off.
Tossed up delivery, Nathan lunges forward in defense.
Pushed to mid off from the front foot.
Two Wides! Down the leg side, Marcus fails to connect. Dhoni doesn't collect it cleanly. Another extra run taken.
FOUR! Shot! Stoinis is playing a really good knock. He takes it on the full and sweeps it with authority through backward square leg for a boundary.

NOT OUT! Floated around off, Stoinis taps it to point and sets off. He is sent back by Coulter-Nile. Kohli is quick to attack the ball and throws it back to Dhoni. The wicket keeper deflects the ball back on the stumps as Marcus dives to get back in. It is referred upstairs. The replays show that some part of the bat is in the air. After having a close look at it, a bit of it is also grounded. It is close but the benefit of the doubt goes to the batsman.
A tight run out appeal is referred upstairs. Kohli is confident. Is Stoinis' bat in the air?
Around the pads, Stoinis looks to play it across but is struck on the pads. Dhoni collects it and there is a slight appeal. The umpire stays put. There was no bat involved.
Floated around off, knocked to long off for a run.
The Australian batsmen are taking a bit of a breather. Meanwhile, Hardik Pandya is off the field and KL Rahul is the substitute in his place. YUZVENDRA CHAHAL is also back for a bowl.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Outside off, placed through point for a single.
Off-cutter on a back of a length outside off, stays low. Coulter-Nile is beaten on the cut.

Fuller in length on middle, Coulter-Nile drives it back towards Pandya who makes a half-stop in his followthrough. He doesn't have the ball in his hand but mimes a throw back to the batsman. The crowd enjoys it.
On a length, angling into the hips. Marcus turns it towards Jadeja at square leg for a run.
Good length delivery outside off, Stoinis plays it with soft hands to cover-point.
HARDIK PANDYA is back into the attack.
Slips in the googly, Nathan fails to read it and gets beaten comprehensively.
Nervy moment! Shortish on off, Coulter-Nile looks to block it but gets an inside edge onto his boots. The ball trickles back just past the leg stump.
Outside off, tapped to short third man for a run.
Wide! Down the leg side, left alone.
Around the leg stump, Marcus looks to defend but takes it on the pads.
FOUR! This one is played with authority! Floated outside off, Stoinis drives it uppishly through extra cover for a majestic boundary.
FOUR! Down the leg side, Stoinis paddle sweeps it towards fine leg. Bumrah runs to his right, slides and stops the ball but unfortunately, the ball trickles down to the fence.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
Full toss outside off, Stoinis goes for a drive but gets an outside edge to Kohli at first slip who makes a good stop.

The short ball almost does the trick again! Around off, Stoinis mistimes his pull to deep mid-wicket. Jadeja near the fence runs across to his right, comes forward a bit and dives full length in front. However, the ball lands just in front of him but he does well to stop it. A terrific effort from the best Indian fielder nonetheless.
Fullish outside off, pushed to covers.
Length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a run.
Angling into Marcus. He tucks it to mid-wicket for a run.
Spinning in sharply from outside off, Nathan looks to keep it out but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Tossed up delivery, driven off the inner half to long on for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Tossed up around off, Coulter-Nile goes for a hit through mid-wicket but gets a top edge. The ball lobs over the slip fielder and rolls towards the fence. Chahal from short third man hares after it, dives full length like a goal keeper to make a brilliant save. Saves a run for his side.
Straighter one outside off, Nathan lets it go. That was not far away from the off stump.
Spinning in sharply from outside off. Nathan is cramped for room but manages to cut it to covers.
Wide! Quicker down on the leg side, Nathan fails to put bat to ball.
Fullish delivery this time, Nathan sweeps it to deep mid-wicket. A single taken.
Googly at a quicker pace on leg stump. Coulter-Nile looks to play it across but is hit on the pads. No real appeal as it was going down leg.
Punched off the backfoot by Stoinis through covers. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Floated around off, Coulter-Nile drives it to through mid off for a run.
Tossed up delivery, Nathan lunges forward in defense.
Shortish delivery outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a run.
YUZVENDRA CHAHAL is back on. Stoinis is having a chat with the umpire, not sure what the reason is.
TRIPLE-WICKET MAIDEN! How often do you see this happening? Well done, Yadav! A bit flatter around middle and leg, pushed back to the bowler.
Pitches it around leg, turning away, Coulter-Nile lunges ahead to defend it down awkwardly.
NATHAN COULTER-NILE is the new man in.

OUT! HAT-TRICK FOR KULDEEP YADAV! And the entire Eden Gardens is up on its feet. What a feat for this man, the feeling would be totally unreal. All his mates barge towards him. Bowls a googly and Cummins lunges forward to defend it. The ball turns away a bit, takes the outside edge and Dhoni behind the stumps doesn't make any mistake. It's the 3rd hat-trick for India in the ODIs. Australia in dire straits now.
PAT CUMMINS is the new man in. A slip and leg slip is in place. He will face the hat-trick ball. Can Kuldeep take it? The Eden Gardens crowd is making a lot of noise and the atmosphere is electric.

OUT! LBW! It's two-in-two for Kuldeep Yadav now. All of a sudden the Aussies are falling here like a pack of cards. Bowls a loopy ball, Agar looks to flick it away but the ball dips in and hits him on the pads right in front of the stumps. A loud appeal to which the umpire raises his finger, after taking his time. Ashton confers with Stoinis if he should opt for the review but his partner says no and gives him his marching order. Can Yadav pick up a hat-trick?
ASHTON AGAR walks out to bat next. Two slips in place for him.

OUT! Dragged on! Kuldeep Yadav picks up his first and Kohli has something to say to Wade. A banter happened when the Indian skipper was batting and he gives it back. Yadav bowls it short and a bit wide outside off, Wade gets across a long way to push it away but gets an inside edge back onto the stumps. 105 needed from 106 balls.
Tossed up around middle and off, Wade prods forward in defense.
Doesn't play at the one which is hurled outside off.

FOUR! Boom! That was a powerful hit from Stoinis! Pandya bowls it short but this one doesn't rise as it did to Smith. Marcus stands tall and pulls it with authority through mid-wicket for a boundary. No need to run for those.
Wide! On a length and a bit wide outside off, Marcus leaves it alone.
Once again on a shorter length, cracked square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Stoinis hangs his bat out and gets it off the outer half. The ball rolls behind point and they take a single.
Slants it away on a length outside off, Wade dabs it with an open face bat towards Chahal at third man for a single. The Aussie wicket keeper is off the mark.
Back of a length delivery outside off, crunched off the back foot through covers for a single.

Drinks taken. A good passage of play for India. Importantly, they have got the big breakthroughs of Maxwell and Smith. The need of the hour for Australia is to keep the scoreboard ticking and stitch a big partnership. They need 6 runs per over. Meanwhile, Ashton Agar is padded up. After he had an issue with the ankle, there was a little doubt whether he will bat or not but it has been cleared now.
Very full outside off, Wade jams it out.
Fullish delivery, defended off the front foot.
Floated on off, in fact it is the googly this time. Negotiated calmly off the front foot.
Tossed up delivery, eased through mid off for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Spinning into Stoinis. He turns it to mid-wicket.
KULDEEP YADAV is back on, replacing Chahal!
Length delivery, defended off the back foot.
MATTHEW WADE is the new man in!

OUT! A massive breakthrough for India! The short delivery which is Pandya's surprise factor brings about the Australian skipper's downfall. He runs in and bowls a cross-seam delivery on a shortish length outside off. Smith shapes for the pull but the ball comes quicker to him than he expects. He ends up getting a top edge to deep mid-wicket. Jadeja (sub for Kedar Jadhav) is a bit late to react, perhaps the floodlights make him a bit blinded. However, he adjusts well, runs in and takes a good catch diving forward. Smith walks back with a dejected face. He played a good knock but his side needed him to stay till the end. Australia need 115 runs from 121 balls with five wickets in hand.
Fullish delivery outside off, Steven taps it to covers.

FOUR! Streaky runs but mighty effective! Length delivery wide outside off. Smith chases it but gets a thick outside edge past the vacant slip region. No protection in the deep and the ball races to the fence.
Length delivery around off, angling in. Stoinis pushes at it but gets a thick inside edge to mid-wicket. The batsmen steal a run.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Marcus taps it to covers and decides against the run.
HARDIK PANDYA has a change of ends.
Flatter delivery on middle, stays a bit low. Smith adjusts to block it.
Kedar Jadhav is ambling out of the field. His foot got stuck while fielding on the previous ball and is looking in some discomfort.

Straighter one around off, a bit of extra bounce as well. Stoinis looks to defend with a straight bat but gets it off the outer half towards short third man. Jadhav runs across from backward point and as he attempts to pick it up, his foot sticks on the ground. A run taken. He seems to be in a bit of discomfort.
Quicker in pace, kept out watchfully.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
That's a gem of a delivery! Floated around leg stump, Stoinis looks to block it but the ball spins away to whiz past his outside edge.
Floated delivery on middle, Stoinis lunges forward in defense.
YUZVENDRA CHAHAL is brought back into the attack.
Fullish around the pads, Marcus clips it through mid-wicket for a run.
Camps back to the flatter delivery and answers it with a straight bat.
FOUR! That's a cracking stroke! Overpitched around off, Stoinis drives it elegantly through covers and the ball whistles away to the fence. This will give him a lot of confidence.
Oohs and Aahs from the Indians! Tossed up on off, spinning in. Stoinis stays back to defend it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Smith waits for this one and works it with the spin to the leg side for a run.
Around off, milked to long off for a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings! On a length on middle, Smith gets inside the line and helps it away through the vacant fine leg region for a boundary.
Short of a length around off, Smith shuffles and defends it to mid on.
Length delivery outside off, Steven fails to put bat to ball.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Angling into Steven. Worked to mid on.
Well bowled! Length delivery outside off, skids through after pitching. Smith pokes at it but gets foxed.
Spinning sharply into Marcus. He makes good use of the crease to block it.
Flighted delivery, Stoinis lunges forward and negotiates it nicely.

18th ODI fifty for Steven Smith! Fullish delivery, Smith turns it through mid on for a run. It has been a good and sensible knock from him. He holds the key for Australia and needs to bat till the end.

An appeal for a catch turned down! On middle and leg, spinning down. Smith looks to flick it away but is struck on the pads. Dhoni collects it and appeals. However, the umpire stays put. The replays confirms that there was no bat involved.
Fullish delivery, clipped to mid-wicket.
Short delivery down the leg side. Smith tries to help it towards fine leg but Dhoni shows good awareness. He stops it nicely with his pad.
Good length delivery in the zone of apprehension. Stoinis lunges forward, feels for it and gets beaten comprehensively.
Full length delivery outside off, driven to mid off.

FOUR! A poor delivery and rightly dealt with! Cross seam delivery on a fullish length on the pads. All Stoinis has to do is to get some bat on it. He does so, clipping it beautifully through square leg to find the desired result!
Ravindra Jadeja is on the field for Kuldeep Yadav.
In the channel outside off, Stoinis doesn't fiddle with it.
Fractionally overpitched around off, Stoinis times it sweetly to mid off.
Back of a length on off, defended solidly off the back foot.
HARDIK PANDYA is back on! A slip in place.
Tossed up on the stumps, Steven looks to work it away on the leg side but gets a leading edge towards point.

Chance of a run out! Smith goes back and nudges it down towards fine leg. He wants the second one as well as Chahal from the deep fires a throw at the striker's end. By the time the throw comes, Smith dives to get back in. Really good running between the wickets. On 49 now!

FOUR! Superb shot! Floats it up outside off, Steven Smith takes a good stride forward and drives it through covers. Finds the gap and picks up a boundary. The skipper is inching closer to his fifty now.
A bit short, around off, punched down to long off for a single.
Gets across and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter, turning down leg, Smith goes back and clips it down to fine leg for a comfortable couple.
KULDEEP YADAV is brought back into the attack.
Flipper from Chahal. It's quicker as well on off. Stoinis lunges forward to defend but gets beaten.
MARCUS STOINIS walks out to bat. A leg slip in place.

OUT! Big, big moment in the game! The dangerous Maxwell departs! Smart bowling from Chahal and he does the trick for India. He sees the batsman coming down the track and bowls it around his legs. Glenn gets into a bit of a tangle. He looks to keep it out to the leg side but fails to put bat to ball. It sneaks through and hits his front pad first. Then it deflects to his back pad and lobs towards Dhoni who is cool as a cucumber, bends ahead and collects it cleanly. As always, he is lightning quick and knocks the stumps over. Once again the big-hitter threatened but fails to make it count. Australia need 147 from 163 balls with six wickets in hand.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Quicker one in line of the stumps, Maxwell defends it back to the bowler.

Sharp work from Dhoni! Slower through the air around off, spinning away. Maxwell lunges forward to block it but gets beaten. Dhoni takes it and whips the bails off in a flash. He doesn't appeal but Kohli appeals vociferously. However, the square leg umpire is not interested. The replays show that Glenn dragged his back foot in.
Flighted delivery around off, driven crisply to Manish Pandey at extra cover who fumbles a touch but doesn't concede a run.
Back of a length wide outside off, Smith doesn't bother to play at it.
On a length around off, Maxwell looks to defend it tentatively but gets it off the inner half through mid-wicket. A run taken.
Good length delivery on middle, sliding down. This time it bounces a touch extra. Maxwell looks to play it across but is struck on the thigh pad.
Short of a length outside off, played to point with an angled bat face.
This pitch is playing tricks! Length delivery around off, stays low. Maxwell looks to keep it out but is beaten on the inside edge.
Back of a length around off, tapped to cover-point.
Change of helmet for Smith. Meanwhile, a bowling change as well. It's JASPRIT BUMRAH who is brought back on.
Tossed up around off, driven to covers.
Played with the spin to point again.
Outside off, stays a bit low. Maxwell places it through point for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Loose stroke! Might have well resulted into a wicket. Chahal knows Maxwell will look to take him on. He further pitches it outside off. Glenn looks to force it through covers but misses.
Fullish delivery, knocked to long off for a run.
Flatter one on leg stump, Smith looks to tuck it away but the ball brushes his pads and goes to Dhoni. An appeal for a leg before follows but it was clearly sliding down leg.
Shortish delivery, punched off the back foot.
Wrong one from Yadav around leg stump. Maxwell fails to read it and fails to keep it out. He is struck on the pads. An appeal for an LBW turned down. It might have pitched outside leg.

SIX! So much of confidence when Maxwell plays cross-batted shots! Flighted around the pads, Maxwell again opts for the slog sweep. He has hit it in the vacant region and the ball clears the square leg fence.

SIX! What a shot! First maximum of the innings and he is continuing from where he left off. That came right off the screws and he is off the mark in style! Tossed up delivery on middle, Maxwell crouches and slog sweeps it with the  spin. Great timing and the ball sails over the deep square leg fence.
Similar length delivery on middle, Maxwell drives it hard back to Yadav.
Fullish delivery on the pads, Smith whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up delivery, clipped through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Stays back to the flatter delivery and defends it calmly.
Floated around the pads, spinning away sharply. Smith is early into his clip and ends up getting a leading edge to covers.
Flighted delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
Fullish delivery, driven hard to mid on where the fielder dives to make a good stop.
Floated on off, kept out watchfully.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Sloppy stuff! Tossed up outside off, driven towards Sharma at covers who makes a mess of it to concede a couple.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, spinning in sharply. Smith looks to defend it but gets struck on the thigh pad.
Close shave! Yorker on off, Smith with a high backlift keeps it out somehow. Gets an inside edge onto his boots. The ball rolls towards the stumps. Steven keeps it away with his bat.
GLENN MAXWELL is the new man in. Will we see him coming out all guns blazing today again?

OUT! You cannot get a softer dismissal than this! A wicket goes down at the wrong time for Australia. Full toss on middle and leg again, Head who has been struggling to pick the spin falls on a full toss. Could have hit it anywhere but instead whips it straight to Manish Pandey at mid-wicket who makes no mistake. Chahal has an embarrassed smile on his face. Look at Kohli go. He is all charged and pumps his fists in the air! India are right back in this contest. 168 needed from 198 balls.
Full toss on middle and leg, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted delivery in line of the stumps, Head milks it to long on for a single.
Tossed up delivery, Head works it in front of square leg for a brace.
Quicker delivery on a fullish length outside off, spinning away. Head kneels and goes for the slog sweep but misses it completely.
Floated delivery, tapped with an open face of the bat to point. A single taken.
Shortish delivery, punched with the spin to covers.
Very full on middle and off, Head digs it out.
There is dew right now. The towel is out and Kuldeep dries the ball. It will be interesting to see how the wrist spinners cope up with it.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tossed up delivery, clipped past square leg for a couple.
Fullish delivery on middle, Head kneels and sweeps it nicely all along the ground to deep mid-wicket. A single taken.

Another LBW appeal denied! Yadav slips in the wrong one around off. Head comes forward to counter it but gets beaten to get rapped on the pads. The Indians appeal again but the umpire stays unmoved. The impact seemed to be outside off again.
KULDEEP YADAV is brought into the attack now.

Time for Drinks. India once again did well to get rid of the Australia's opening batsmen but the current pair of Smith and Head has steadied the ship considerably. The inclusion of spin has seen Head stutter a bit. Remember, he is already been given a reprieve by Rohit Sharma. Can he make the most of it?
Quicker one on the pads, Travis helps it behind square square leg for a single.

A loud shout for an LBW turned down! Floated around off, spinning in. Head strides forward to keep it out but misses to get pinged on the pad. The Men in Blue appeal in unison but the umpire stays put. Kohli gets into an animated chat with Dhoni. He also asks Chahal whether it is bat or pad first. The leg spinner is not sure and eventually the hosts decide against the review. The replays show that there was no bat but the impact was in question. Turns out to be a wise decision not to challenge the decision.
Eased through mid off for a run.
Vicious spin again. Floated around the pads, a bit shorter in length this time. Smith is early into his clip and gets a leading edge to point,.
Good amount of turn. Floated outside leg, turning in. Smith looks to work it against the spin but gets a safe leading edge to covers.
Floated around off, Head knocks it through mid off for a run.
Fullish delivery outside off, Steven mistimes his drive to mid off.

Straight on this occasion from Pandya. Smith helps it through square leg. Chahal in the deep sprints to his left, slides and makes a good stop. He parries it to Kuldeep. Good team work. Two runs taken.
Pandya switches angle and runs in from around the wicket. Head drives it through point for a run.
FOUR! Timed exquisitely! Length delivery on middle and leg, Head tucks it towards wide mid on. Bumrah runs across to his left but he has no chance to stop it. Another boundary results.
Fullish delivery around off, eased to covers.

Fullish delivery angling into Head. He flicks it nicely through mid-wicket. There is a shy at the non-striker's end from the fielder in the deep as the batsmen attempt the second run. Kohli rushes from extra cover and makes a good stop.
Floated delivery, turned through square leg for a run. A steady start from Chahal, three runs from it.
Shorter in length on middle and leg, Head works it off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Fullish delivery on off, knocked down to long on for a run.
Flighted around off, tapped towards covers. Smith looks for a run but decides against it as the fielder is quick to attack the ball.
Tossed up outside off, driven crisply to short cover.
Slow through the air on middle, tucked through in front of square on the leg side for a run.
Dhoni is getting some tape on his left glove. There's a bowling change too. Time for spin now. YUZVENDRA CHAHAL is brought into the attack.

A stifled appeal for an LBW denied! Length delivery outside off, shaping in sharply. Smith looks to keep it out but misses to get struck high on the pads. The ball deflects through the vacant slip region and rolls to the third man ropes. Four Leg Byes signaled by the umpire. The 50-run stand is up as well.
Short delivery from Pandya which he uses quite well. It is well-directed as well. Smith shapes for the hook but bails out at the last moment.

FOUR! He hardly seemed to hit it but look at the result! Very full outside off, Smith jams it towards mid on. The fielder is a bit wide at the same region. Once it goes past him, the result is destined. Smith is growing in confidence.
Back of a length outside off, defended stoutly from the back foot.

FOUR! Shot! Fuller in length outside off, Smith shuffles across, puts a decent stride forward and times it crisply through extra cover. The outfield is lightning quick and the ball races to the fence in a jiffy.
Full length delivery outside off, swinging in. Smith goes for an expansive drive but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Good length delivery outside off, Smith cuts it in a weird manner to deep point to Chahal. A run taken and he will retain strike. Another tight over from Kumar.
Half-volley outside off, Smith drives it crisply but finds the man at covers. He is not happy with himself.
Full length delivery outside off, Smith moves across his stumps and mistimes his drive to mid off.
Length delivery well outside outside off, angling in. Smith is aware where his off stump is and makes a good leave.
Similar length delivery outside off and width on offer. Travis cuts it to third man for a single.
Back of a length in line of the stumps, defended solidly off the back foot to the left of the bowler.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled by the umpire. Maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
Length delivery on off, Smith gets behind the line of the delivery to defend it but gets it off the inner half on the track.
Back of a length delivery outside off, holding its line. Steven points his bat skywards to let it go.
Smith is not happy with the sightscreen and stops Pandya in his delivery stride.

Great effort in the field! Fullish delivery around off, Head goes for a booming drive but it squirts off the outer half to covers. Pandya dives full length to his right and takes some pace off it. Rahane from the same region hares after it and slides near the fence to keep the ball in play. Saves a run for his side.
A bit of halt in play. The grass has gotten stuck around the spikes of Pandya's shoes and he is clearing the dirt with the bail...
FOUR! This time Travis gets hold of it! Short delivery, sits up nicely for Head. He stands tall and pulls it with aplomb over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Similar length delivery outside off, defended solidly off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery around off, stays low. Head goes for the pull but is completely outfoxed by the low bounce. This wicket is playing tricks.
HARDIK PANDYA comes into the attack.
Good length delivery in line of the stumps, Smith defends it stoutly.
The batsman has nudged the ball fine down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Shortish outside off, cut away to point.
Length delivery outside off, swings in. Head looks to force it through the off side but is beaten on the inside edge.
Fullish delivery just outside off, Travis covers his stumps and leaves it.
Loose shot! Length delivery outside off, Head slogs hard at it but misses.

Four Byes! On a length on middle, Smith moves across and looks to clip it away but the ball kisses his pads and goes past Dhoni. No protection in the deep and the ball rolls to the fine leg fence. However, the replays show that it didn't strike the pads.
Great comeback from Bumrah after being hit for two boundaries. Yorker at the base of off stump. Smith shuffles and does well to jam it out. Gets an inside edge to his boots.
FOUR! Bumrah is losing his radar! Short and width on offer. Smith slaps it through point for a rocketing boundary.
FOUR! Brilliant shot! Full length delivery outside off. Smith shuffles across and whips it through mid-wicket. At Eden Gardens you just need to find the gap and it results into a boundary.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Back of a length delivery well outside off, stays low. Smith goes for the punch but is foxed by it.

Dropped! Length delivery on off, seaming away a bit after pitching. Head feels for it and gets a thick outside edge. Rohit Sharma at first slip lines it up and crouches to his right. He gets his hands to it but puts it down. That was a pretty easy chance. How costly will this prove?
FOUR! Easy pickings! Length delivery on the leg stump, Head doesn't miss out. He clips it nicely through square leg and the ball races to the fence.
Fullish in line of the stumps, flicked to mid-wicket.
Fullish in length outside off, leaving the southpaw. Head doesn't flirt with it. Sensible batting.
Close shave! Good length delivery around off, Smith goes for the punch but not with much conviction. Ends up getting a bottom edge past his stumps. The batsmen sneak in a run.
Back of a length outside off, Steven adopts a circumspect approach and leaves it.
Full delivery outside off, swinging away. Head chases it but misses. Dhoni dives to his left but doesn't collect it cleanly.
Fullish outside off, played with an open face through point for a run.
Straying on the pads, Travis clips it nicely through front of square on the leg side. Chahal sprints after it, slides near the fence and makes a good leave. Saves a run for his side.
Shaping away from Head. He covers his stumps to let it go.
FOUR! A rare loose delivery from Bumrah and it has been put away. Shortish and room on offer. Head punches it with authority behind point to find the fence.

FOUR! Very fortunate! Good length delivery around off, Head goes for a tentative punch but gets a thick outside edge. The ball goes through the gap between his legs and the leg stump and eventually reaches the fence.
Slanting into the pads, Head misses his tuck and wears it on his pads. The ball rolls to the leg side. A leg bye taken.
TRAVIS HEAD comes out to bat. Australia need a big partnership.

OUT! Another one goes down! This time it is the big wicket of David Warner. He wasn't looking that confident and eventually departs! Fuller length delivery on off, shaping away. Warner pushes at it with minimal foot movement and ends up getting a thick outside edge. Rahane at wide second slip is sharp as a hawk. He watches it all the way, bends low to his right and takes a good catch. Second wicket for Kumar and the Eden Gardens crowd is right behind the Men in Blue. The tourists are in a spot of bother now.
On a length around off, slanting away. David lets it go.
A bit short this time, leaving the southpaw. Warner doesn't fiddle with it.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Another peach! Short of a length, slanting across Warner. He pushes at it tentatively and gets beaten by the extra bounce.
A tad fuller in length outside off, Smith shuffles across and defends it.
FOUR! Streaky runs! Fuller length delivery outside off, Smith goes for a drive but gets a thick outside edge wide of second slip for a boundary. India won't mind that.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
That's a jaffa! Good length delivery outside off, shaping away after hitting the seam. Smith pokes at it but gets beaten all ends up. That was very close to the outside edge.
Length delivery angling into Smith. He works it through square leg for a brace and gets off the mark.
Bumrah runs in from over the wicket with two slips and a gully in place. He bowls a length delivery around off. Warner pushes it through point for a run.
STEVEN SMITH strides out to bat. This is his 100th ODI. Can he play a match-winning knock for Australia?

OUT! The pressure has resulted in Cartwright throwing his wicket away! Intelligent bowling as well from Kumar. He goes wider of the crease and bowls a length ball around off. It swings in ever so slightly. Hilton goes for an expansive drive but leaves a lot of gap between his bat and pad. He misses it completely to find his stumps shattered. Another failure for the young man. Not a good start to his ODI career, 21 out of the 23 balls he has faced in ODIs have been dots, has scored just 2 runs and is now dismissed twice (all bowled). A wicket-maiden for Kumar.
Kumar bowls this one on a good length outside off, Hilton makes another leave. Five dot balls. The pressure is building up.
Full delivery on off, the right-hander puts his head down and defends it calmly.
Fuller in length on off, Hilton strides ahead and taps it to point. This is tight stuff from Kumar.
A tad fuller around off this time. Cartwright lunges ahead and lets it go confidently.
In the corridor of uncertainty, stays a bit low. Hilton doesn't fiddle with it.
That's a peach! On a length, hits the deck and seams away substantially. Warner lets it go watchfully. Bumrah starts off with a maiden.
Leg bye! Fullish delivery on middle and leg, Cartwright looks to help it across but is struck on the pads. Stifled appeal for an LBW denied.
Loose shot! Short of a length outside off, seaming away after pitching. Hilton pushes at it with minimal foot movement but gets beaten all ends up. The crowd is interested but there was no bat there.
Fuller in length outside off, pushed towards cover-point.
Good length delivery in line of the stumps, defended solidly off the back foot.

That was close! Back of a length around off, shaping in sharply. Cartwright trusts the bounce of the pitch and points his bat skywards to let it go. The ball just goes over the off stump and into the gloves of Dhoni.
JASPRIT BUMRAH to bowl with the second new ball from the other end. Two slips in place for him as well.
On a length around off, this one curves back in. Warner covers the line and defends it stoutly. Good start from Kumar.
Fuller length delivery on off, swinging away. Warner plants his front foot across to allow it through.

First run for Australia! Angling into Cartwright. He tucks it towards square leg and takes off. Warner responds and hares across. Chahal is quick to attack the ball but misses his shy at the striker's end.
On a length around off, tapped with an open bat face towards point.
Ouch! Good length delivery angling into Cartwright. He looks to tuck it through but gets hit near the box region. If that doesn't wake him up, nothing will.
Kumar starts off with a length delivery in the zone of apprehension. Gets some away swing as well. Cartwright makes a watchful leave.
We are back for the chase. DAVID WARNER and HILTON CARTWRIGHT to open the batting for Australia. BHUVNESHWAR KUMAR to start off with the first new ball for India. Two slips in place. Here we go...
